generation_prompt: The robot uses its left hand to grasp the blue clock from the bottom wooden shelf, lift it free, and carry it over the teal plate. It lowers the clock near the plate's center and opens its fingers, leaving the clock on the plate with its hand still close to the clock. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: Blue clock rests on its base near the center of the teal plate. Left fingers are open, with hand immediately adjacent and thumb visually overlapping the clock surface; hand has not withdrawn clear. Right hand remains away from task objects.

arm_hand_roles.left: Active hand grasps the clock around its body, lifts/removes it from shelf, transports and lowers it to plate, then opens fingers beside it.
arm_hand_roles.right: Remains raised at the right side without touching clock, shelf, or plate; provides no task support.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Single-hand manipulation; no transfer or coordinated two-hand contact.

uncertainties: The final left thumb overlaps the clock surface, so complete separation of every digit and fully stable unsupported settling are not directly shown; opening fingers and placement on the plate are visible.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
